FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 226 PFH 2022 Dated:11-10-
2022 regarding altering the limits of Malagatti Village of Shorapur taluk Yadgiri
District and constituting a new revenue village called Tipanatagi was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 226 PFH 2022 dated:13-10-2022 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within
thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
dated:13-10-2022 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Malagatti of Shorapur taluk in Yadagiri District to form a new revenue
(20836)

won 2 BMF RE BH, Dorsaod, 50, @Fowo*, 5095 SOSA
village called Tipanatagi of Shorapur taluk Yadagiri district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 207 GLH 22022 Dated:. 12-10-2022
regarding altering the limits of Bennur(B) village of Chittapur Taluk and

Kalaburagi District and constituting a new revenue village called Bennur(B) Tanda
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 207 GLH 2022
Dated:13.10.2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:13.10.2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;

Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Bennur(B) of Chittapur taluk in Kalburagi District to form a new revenue
village called Bennur(B) Tanda of Chittapur taluk Kalburagi district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA
RD 297 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bangalore, Date:15-12-2022

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 297 PFH 2022
Dated:. 12-10-2022 regarding altering the limits of Tengali village of Kalgi Taluk
and Kalaburagi District and constituting a new revenue village called
Bhimeshwarnagar was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD
297 PFH 2022 dated:13-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:13-10-2022.
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Tengali of Kalgi taluk in Kalburagi District to form a new revenue village
called Bhimeshwarnagar of Kalgi taluk Kalburagi district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 302 PFH 2022 Dated:. 12-
10-2022 regarding altering the limits of Chincholli H village of Kalgi Taluk and
Kalaburagi District and constituting a new revenue village called Kohinoor Thanda
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 302 PFH 2022
dated:13-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:13-10-
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas specified
in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said village
Chincholli H of Kalgi taluk in Kalburagi District to form a new revenue village called
Kohinoor Thanda of Kalgi taluk Kalburagi district along with the survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 294 PFH 2022 Dated:13-10-

Sakkunayak nagar was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD
294 PFH 2022 dated:14-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on

here by makes the following notification, namely:

village called as as Ramachandranayak nagar of Chincholi taluk and Kalaburagi
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of notification No. RD 98 LRD 2021, dated 25.04.2022,
regarding alteration of the limits of Muragod Circle (Hobli) by excluding the villages
of Sutagatti, Enagi, Hittanagi and include into the Savadatti Hobli and Taluk in
Belagavi District was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka Act 12 of 1964) in Part IV-A of the Karnataka
Gazette, dated: 27-04-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within one month from the date of its publication in
the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on 27-04-
2022.
And whereas no objections and suggestions have been received in this
behalf by the State Government.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of
section 4 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka Act 12 of 1964),
the Government of Karnataka hereby makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE
The villages Specified in column (3) of the table below shall be excluded from
the limits of the specified in column (2) and shall be included within the limits of
the circle specified in column (4) thereof.

circle (hobli) specified in column (4) thereof,-
